owners.SS: exact-profile validation, authentication, staging and session transition
owners.RS: authenticated durable commit, restore and reconciliation evidence

RESTORE: authenticated selector-bound INDETERMINATE hold from SS/RS when restoreClassification is RESTORED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED
reconciliationReference32 from the authenticated kind-13 hold

rules.closedObjects: unknown fields and values reject before mutation
rules.tupleDrift: UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE before mutation; no negotiation or fallback
rules.bindingMismatch: AP originates bindingRef from its opaque application context; SS compares it with the session binding established by C-BIND; mismatch is BINDING_MISMATCH before mutation and never authority by itself
rules.derivedFacts: AP cannot supply RS commit outcomes, epochs, replay identities, proposal shape, committer identities, candidates, witness facts or authenticated profile facts

rsTriState.COMMITTED: apply the complete staged logical mutation once and emit SUCCESS; if response emission is interrupted, retain reconciliation evidence and never report REJECTED
rsTriState.NOT_COMMITTED: discard the staged mutation, restore originalStateBefore and emit NOT_COMMITTED without output
rsTriState.INDETERMINATE: includes every absent, failed or unknown RS outcome after a commit request; retain originalStateBefore and held mutation internally, apply nothing, enter RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, emit no operation output and forbid blind retry

rules.internalFailureBoundary: FAIL_CLOSED_INTERNAL applies only before any RS commit request; after a request any missing/failed/unknown outcome is INDETERMINATE, and after COMMITTED the adapter emits success or retains reconciliation evidence but never emits REJECTED
rules.framingEpochBeforeAuthentication: SS structurally parses bounded framing and rejects past distance at least six or a future epoch at P07 without trusting content; only distance 0 through 5 continues to key-dependent authentication at P08 and replay lookup at P09
rules.replayOrder: for authenticated distance 0 through 5, unseen identity continues and an exact duplicate emits DUPLICATE_IGNORED; framing-window cases and replay cases are disjoint
rules.candidateSelector: APPLY_PEER_UPDATE compares the current authoritative candidate with one incoming authenticated same-parent candidate only when the current transition is the immediately preceding eligible proposal-free local self-update committed through CAPI-S014 and the authenticated raw 32-byte committer identities are distinct; unsigned lexicographic comparison selects the lower; equal-committer, re-presented, peer-predecessor and every other pair is UNSUPPORTED_COMMIT_SHAPE; selected complete state commits and the valid loser remains non-authoritative retained evidence
rules.payloadRelease: application, Welcome and Commit bytes appear only in SUCCESS after COMMITTED; never in other kinds
rules.restore: RS classifies the complete stored set into mutually exclusive cases: no session material; only legacy or tuple/version-drifted session records; exactly one exact-profile M2 candidate with no additional nonlegacy candidate; or multiple/mixed nonlegacy candidates. Preserved legacy bytes beside exactly one exact-profile M2 candidate are ignored and never make that candidate incompatible. SS and RS synchronously revalidate the exact candidate before RESTORED; decoded bytes are never a public state and remain non-authoritative on any failure. For exactly one exact-profile M2 candidate, the C-REST classification of its authenticated authority selects the row: RESTORED_ACTIVE is CAPI-S003; RESTORED_EMPTY is CAPI-S031 RESTORED_EMPTY_SESSION with state EMPTY and no output; RESTORED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED whose authenticated selector-bound INDETERMINATE hold passes the I-RESTART loader is CAPI-S030; a hold that fails the loader is the fail-closed AUTHENTICATED_STATE_INCONSISTENT of CAPI-S004. No other C-REST success reaches a RESTORE row
rules.restoreFacts: restoreClassification, the authenticated selector-bound INDETERMINATE hold and its 32-byte reconciliationReference are SS/RS-owned observation facts of RESTORE, never AP input. From the hold SS rebuilds the complete reconciliation snapshot it would have held after the original INDETERMINATE response, including originalStateBefore, the operation identity and, for CAPI-S017, selectedCandidateRef. AP cannot supply, select or alter any of them
rules.restoreReexposure: CAPI-S030 re-exposes an existing durable hold after a restart: it emits commitOutcome INDETERMINATE, originalStateBefore and the reconciliationRef of that hold, enters RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, starts no new uncertain commit, issues no RS commit request, and writes, releases or clears nothing. Its response is a prior INDETERMINATE response emitted by SS in the sense of RECONCILE_INDETERMINATE
rules.reconciliationReferenceForm: the emitted reconciliationRef is exactly "I-SM-HOLD:" followed by the unpadded base64url encoding of the 32-byte kind-13 reconciliationReference, 53 characters in total; the original INDETERMINATE emission and CAPI-S030 use the same function, so the two emissions are byte-equal; the 32-byte reference reaches the adapter only as an SS/RS-owned observation fact; an AP echo that is not exactly this form, or whose decoded bytes differ from the held reference, is RECONCILIATION_REFERENCE_MISMATCH (CAPI-S028) with no mutation

operationIdentityForm.form: unpadded base64url encoding of the 32-byte SS/RS operation identity: exactly 43 characters, canonical, decoding to nonzero bytes
operationIdentityForm.replaces: the free string bounded by MAX_OPERATION_IDENTITY_CHARS = 246
operationIdentityForm.violation: an identity longer than 43 characters exceeds the structural bound and is VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE (CAPI-E014) at P06, as the replaced bound was; any other non-conforming identity, that is one of at most 43 characters that is shorter, outside the base64url alphabet, non-canonical or decoding to all-zero bytes, is a defect of an SS_RS fact and is FAIL_CLOSED_INTERNAL (CAPI-E025) under C-MUT section 3; both are detected when the MutationEnvelope is formed, strictly before any RS commit request: no commit request is sent and nothing is held

restartAssumption.statement: Assumption, stated explicitly: in M2 the adapter, the I-TXN driver and the port run in the existing dedicated vault worker, which dies with its page; the M2 worker runtime is deferred to M3.
consequences: Every relaunch therefore starts the adapter at EMPTY and reaches CAPI-S030 again.
Within one worker, RESTORE in RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED stays the CAPI-G018 reject, because AP already holds the reference from S030.
A shared worker or a service worker is out of scope.

rules.keyPackageProvisioning: C-BIND owns local framed KeyPackage issuance at the SS bootstrap boundary; SS/RS own its reference and one-shot state; AP can supply only peer KeyPackage bytes and Welcome bytes
rules.peerMaterial: CREATE emits opaque embedded-tree Welcome bytes; SELF_UPDATE emits opaque protected Commit bytes; APPLY_PEER_UPDATE consumes one incoming Commit and either applies a current-parent update or selects the exact bounded same-parent pair; no transport semantics follow
rules.singleWriter: I-LOCK prevents a second active context before it invokes this API; session-active-elsewhere is therefore an outer UI/controller result, not an adapter result
rules.coarseAnchorRegression: RESTORE maps an authenticated regressed coarse external anchor to AUTHENTICATED_STATE_INCONSISTENT; absence of such an anchor makes no rollback-prevention claim
rules.legacy: legacy session bytes are never accepted, imported or cleaned up
rules.issue312: affected operations are absent from operationEnum and therefore UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION before mutation; no local-observation extension
rules.runtimeArtifactSuite: ciphersuite fields identify the SS-0 evidenced suite and do not assert which suite is compiled into the frozen WASM artifact; F-WASM owns that feasibility determination
